### Steps
1. Always pull changes at the start of your session to get the most recent version of the file. 
2. Make your edits. To push the changes, save the file, and the do the following:
3. in RStudio, in the top right panel, press the "Git" tab. Then find the file(s) you've edited, and check their box under "Staged"
4. Press "Commit" to stage these changes. You'll need to enter a commit message (typically this helps your collaborators know what changes you've made)
5. Press "Push". 
6. Check the github to see if your changes successfully pushed.
7. To pull, press the "Pull" button in the "Git" tab.
